items.statement: The submitted workflow optimizes the specified neutral singlet ion pair and validates the reported structure with harmonic frequencies.
items.expected: A converged optimization and an explicit imaginary-frequency count are documented.

items.statement: The submission identifies the dominant vertical excitation from a documented excitation list and retains its orbital contribution.
items.expected: A selection rule and excitation evidence identify one dominant transition.

items.statement: The gas-phase AMP-TFA HOMO-LUMO gap is reproduced.
items.expected: The reported gap is approximately 6.008 eV.

items.statement: The dominant listed UV transition is reproduced and assigned.
items.expected: The dominant transition is approximately 271.84 nm and is HOMO-to-LUMO / pi-to-pi-star.
